moreHP.name: More HP (Alt Rule)
moreHP.hint: Optional scaling HP rule. Once a Tier 2 path is taken, the character gains +1 HP per character level (starting at level 5). Once a Tier 3 path is taken, levels 10+ instead grant +2 HP per level.

creationMode.name: Character Creation Mode
creationMode.hint: How players generate attribute scores for new characters. Point Buy shows the budget tracker; Random Roll shows the attribute roller.

alternateAnatomy.name: Alternate Hit Location Anatomies (Alt Rule)
alternateAnatomy.hint: Enable the Bestiary anatomy charts: anatomy-specific protection rows and anatomy selection on character sheets.

fatePoints.name: Fate Points (Alt Rule)
fatePoints.hint: Enable the Bestiary's Motivation and Fate Point controls on character sheets.

itemPowerSlots.name: Item of Power Slot Rules
itemPowerSlots.hint: Use the standard equipment slots or the expanded alternate slot table.

attunement.name: Item of Power Attunement Rules
attunement.hint: Use ordinary attunement, remove attunement, or allow technological items to use attunement slots for radiation protection.

skipRollDialog.name: Skip Roll Dialogs
skipRollDialog.hint: Roll immediately with default options when you click a roll. Hold Shift to open the roll dialog instead. When off, Shift-click skips the dialog.

{world} was made with an older version of The Fade. Its characters and items need a one-time update to work with this version.

encounter.hint: Roll when travel, noise, conspicuous magic, or new territory may draw trouble.
encounter.triggerHint: An encounter occurs when {formula} totals {threshold} or more.
encounter.noRollHint: No encounter roll is required in a safe area.
encounter.escalationHint: Each non-hostile encounter at Moderate danger or higher raises escalation by 1, widening the hostile range of the type die. A hostile encounter resets it to 0.
encounter.noEscalationHint: Escalation does not apply at this danger level.

challenge.hint: Track a multi-step party problem with escalating consequences.

gear.hint: Determine how difficult a particular weapon, armor piece, relic, or restricted item is to acquire.
gear.finalHint: Cannot be reduced below 2; AL 12+ generally cannot be bought normally.
gear.markup: Difficult goods may carry markups of +25%, +50%, +100%, or more. Haggling reduces the marked-up price, but the merchant's minimum acceptable percentage is still based on the original price.
gear.failedCheck: A failed AL check may delay another attempt, reveal a lesser or flawed alternative, attract unwanted attention, or provide a lead elsewhere. Rare gear may be commissioned when a buyer can find a craftsperson and the required materials.

chat.subtitle: Access Level
chat.unbuyable: AL 12+ generally cannot be bought normally.
chat.skill: The GM chooses the skill appropriate to the acquisition attempt.

power.hint: These world settings are also available under Configure Settings.
power.saved: Item of Power world rules updated.

overlap.heading: Overlap or No Overlap?
overlap.head: Helmets, crowns, circlets, masks, hoods, cowls, headbands, and turbans overlap. Earrings, monocles, eye patches, hair pins, and jaw guards do not.
overlap.body: Most non-armor pieces can be worn over or under armor. An Item of Power shaped as armor overlaps and should use its armor-conflict and location fields. Armor+ pieces receive the normal Armor+ benefit.
overlap.hands: Gauntlets, vambraces, and pauldrons overlap. Bracers, gloves, and wristbands do not and can be worn together. Mark non-overlapping accessories on their item sheet.

alternate.heading: Alternate Item of Power Slots
alternate.hint: The expanded system separates similar-looking items where reasonable. A dash means the slot is unchanged or did not previously exist.
alternate.becomes: Becomes this slot if it is…
alternate.rings: One per finger or similar appendage rather than two total.
alternate.sheaths: Four practical positions—left hip, right hip, back of hip, and backpack. GMs may allow sensible stacking while attunement remains the limiting rule.

removing.heading: Removing Attunement
removing.text: When enabled, equipped Items of Power function without attunement checks or slot limits. This removes much of the incentive for non-magic characters to preserve Soul for attunement capacity.

technology.heading: Technology-Affected Attunement
technology.text: Technological items can be marked as attuned against magical radiation. Each protected item consumes an attunement slot and is treated as stabilized against radiation-driven malfunction.

dark.heading: Dark Magic Items
dark.text: Items created through souls, innocent blood, ritual sacrifice, Hell, corruption damage, consumed life or sanity, dark gods, or cosmic horrors are Dark Magic Items. Their gray-black flame or light-absorbing aura is visible to creatures that perceive magical auras.
dark.attuned: gain Sin equal to Corruption Value each dawn.
dark.addiction: crossing the Sin Threshold triggers a Dark Magic attack against Grit, using Corruption Value as its base dice.

Opposed.title: Opposed Roll
Opposed.lead: Both sides roll their pools. More successes wins; a tie goes to the opponent (defender).
Opposed.noActors: No other actors are available for an opposed roll.
Opposed.notFound: Opposed roll: the opponent could not be found.

Aid.title: Aid Another
Aid.lead: Help an ally with a skill you have at Learned rank or better. Roll it at DT {dt}; on a success the ally gains +1D on their check with the same skill.
Aid.skillHint: Only skills at Learned rank or better are listed.
Aid.helperLimit: An ally can be helped by one character at Learned, plus one more per rank above Learned (up to six at Mastered).
Aid.combatHint: Aid Another is used outside combat only, and the GM may rule it out for some skills.
Aid.noActors: No other actors are available to aid.
Aid.noSkills: {name} has no skill at Learned rank or better, which Aid Another requires.
Aid.notFound: Aid Another: the ally could not be found.
Aid.requiresRank: Aid Another requires Learned rank or better in the skill (you have {rank}).
Aid.failure: The aid fails; no bonus dice are granted.

Ignition.title: Ignition
Ignition.subtitle: {name} · {intensity} · {radius} hex
Ignition.startCost: Igniting costs a Minor Action. Allies within the radius join as a free action on their turn, or a Reaction outside it.
Ignition.effectSense: Sense the life force of allies in the Ignition
Ignition.effectsApplied: The dice bonuses are added to each participant's temporary bonuses until the Ignition ends.
Ignition.actionsHeading: Ignition Actions (each once per Ignition, spent for everyone)
Ignition.endedLine: Ended ({reason}). Everyone who took part recovers for {hours} hour(s).
Ignition.endedNoRecovery: Ended ({reason}). No allies joined, so no recovery is needed.
Ignition.endedNote: {name}'s Ignition has ended ({reason}). Everyone who took part must wait {hours} hour(s) before igniting or joining another Ignition.
Ignition.joinCost: Joining is a free action on your turn, or a Reaction outside it.
Ignition.hp: HP to everyone in the Ignition
Ignition.flareDamage: +{damage} damage to the triggering attack ({count} in the Ignition × 15).
Ignition.flareEnds: Flare of Purpose ends the Ignition for everyone.
Ignition.needIntensity: Set an Aura Intensity (Faint, Moderate, or Intense) before igniting.
Ignition.recovering: {name} is still recovering from an Ignition ({minutes} min remaining).
Ignition.recoveringOverride: {name} is still recovering from an Ignition ({minutes} min remaining). Ignore recovery and continue?
Ignition.noToken: Place a token for {name} on the viewed scene before igniting.
Ignition.notActive: That Ignition is no longer active.
Ignition.onlyInitiator: Only the owner of {name} (the initiator) or a GM can end this Ignition.
Ignition.noInitiatorToken: The initiator's token is no longer on its scene.
Ignition.noAllyToken: {name} has no token on the Ignition's scene.
Ignition.noOwnedToken: You have no character within {radius} hex of {name} who can join.
Ignition.noOwnedParticipant: None of your characters are in this Ignition.
Ignition.notParticipant: Only a participant in this Ignition can perform its actions.
Ignition.needAlly: Ignition Actions can only be performed once an ally has joined the Ignition.
Ignition.noTargets: There are no other participants to designate.
Ignition.actionSpent: {action} has already been used in this Ignition.

sharedSurge.label: Shared Surge
sharedSurge.hint: As a Minor Action, you and an ally within Ignition you designate receive +2D to the next roll you or they make within the duration of the Ignition.

interlinkedDefense.label: Interlinked Defense
interlinkedDefense.hint: You can designate two other allies; you and your allies designated share their Defense stats (effectively using the highest among them) against the next attack roll they each individually would suffer. This benefit disappears if not triggered within 4 rounds.

echoedStrikes.label: Echoed Strikes
echoedStrikes.hint: When making an attack roll if you successfully hit and deal damage, an ally within the aura's radius can expend their Reaction to make a free attack roll, even if they'd normally be out of range, as the spectral energy from their spirit charges your own attack for a follow-up.

harmonicFlow.label: Harmonic Flow
harmonicFlow.hint: You can cast a spell you don't know but an ally within the Ignition knows.

resonantHealing.label: Resonant Healing
resonantHealing.hint: As a Minor Action you can activate a burst of healing energy: all allies within the Ignition heal 2D immediately.

combatUnity.label: Combat Unity
combatUnity.hint: As a Minor Action, you can treat yourself as possessing the Talent of an ally within the Ignition, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

flareOfPurpose.label: Flare of Purpose
flareOfPurpose.hint: You can activate this after making a successful attack, however doing so will end the Ignition for everyone. You increase the damage of your attack by 15 per ally within the Ignition (including yourself).

Ignition.outOfRange: {name} is outside {initiator}'s Ignition radius and loses its bonuses until they return.
Ignition.backInRange: {name} is back inside {initiator}'s Ignition radius and regains its bonuses.

Damage.braceBlocked: Brace for Impact: the excess is blocked from HP.
Damage.braceHalved: Brace for Impact: HP damage halved.
